title: Assistant: Store Policies and Human Handoff
summary: Give the store one written policy document the assistant answers from (and only from), and let a customer hand off to a person: the assistant publishes a handoff event through Kafka that the notification service logs once (design doc Phase 3).

acceptanceCriteria.text: One policy document (returns, shipping, warranty, payment, cancellation) with concrete terms; editing it changes answers without code changes.
At least 9 of 10 scripted policy questions answered with the document's facts; none contradicts it.
3 uncovered questions: says it doesn't know and offers a person; invents no policy.
On request (or accepted offer): confirmation + reference in the same turn, exactly one handoff event; never unasked.
Notification logs exactly one support notification per handoff within 5 s.
Repeat request in a conversation returns the same reference, no new event; a replayed event notifies once.
The event's user ID always comes from the verified identity.
Kafka down: assistant says support couldn't be reached, chat keeps working, nothing claims success.
No transcript in the event or logs; summary at most 500 characters.
Handoff topic and payload defined once in shared with a parser; producer and consumer use it; contract test.
Works on the local model live and on Claude via stubbed unit tests.
New logic unit-tested without Kafka, Redis or a model; each test seen failing once.
Changed services rebuilt and healthy; design doc, READMEs, architecture and README event flow updated.

openQuestions.text: Policy text: I draft sample terms (30-day returns, free shipping over $50, 1-year warranty, ...) for your review? Proposed: yes.
Where handoffs go? Proposed: notification logs a simulated support email; no ticketing/admin page.
Event contents? Proposed: reference, user/conversation IDs, timestamp, reason category, summary of at most 500 characters; no transcript or email.
When to hand off? Proposed: only when asked or after the customer accepts an offer.
Handoffs per conversation? Proposed: one; a repeat returns the same reference.
Model and bar? Proposed: LM Studio Qwen3 30B, at least 9/10 grounded, 3/3 no invention; Claude via stubbed tests.
Notify the customer too? Proposed: no, chat confirmation only.
